# odinex Provider

The Odinex Cloud provider manages servers, networks, volumes, firewalls, floating IPs, NAT gateways, Elastic IPs, load balancers and more through the [Odinex Cloud API](https://docs.odinex.cloud/api). Authenticate with a project API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    odinex = {
      source = "odinex-cloud/odinex"
    }
  }
}

# Configure with a project API token. Prefer the ODINEX_TOKEN environment variable.
provider "odinex" {
  token = var.odinex_token
}

variable "odinex_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Defaults to `https://api.odinex.cloud/v1`. Can also be set with `ODINEX_ENDPOINT`.
- `poll_interval` (String) How often to poll running actions, as a Go duration (e.g. `500ms`, `2s`). Defaults to `1s`. Can also be set with `ODINEX_POLL_INTERVAL`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Project API token (`odx_…`). Can also be set with the `ODINEX_TOKEN` environment variable.
